User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Allow crawling of main content
Allow: /index.php
Allow: /movie.php
Allow: /tag.php
Allow: /assets/

# Disallow raw internal component/template directories (prevents redirect loops and crawling of PHP include files)
Disallow: /components/
Disallow: /layout/

# Allow crawling of sitemaps
Allow: /sitemap-*.xml

# Allow crawling of news and entertainment content
Allow: /news/
Allow: /quicknews/

# Disallow search result pages and internal search endpoints (Standing Rule)
# Never allow on-site search / open-query surfaces to be indexed — that was the spam door.
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /search.php
Disallow: /pages/search
Disallow: /pages/search.php
Disallow: /pages/search-redirect
Disallow: /pages/search-redirect.php
Disallow: /*?q=
Disallow: /*&q=
Disallow: /*?*search=
Disallow: /*?*term=

# Disallow the login flow and account pages (crawlers following them cost a PHP render each)
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /pages/login.php
Disallow: /logout
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /account
Disallow: /edit-account
Disallow: /signup

# Tag, person and company pages are indexed at their plain address; the parameter copies (?tag=, ?page=,
# ?region=, ?sort=) are thousands of near-duplicates. /login above already covers /login?redirect=...
Disallow: /tag/*?
Disallow: /person/*?
Disallow: /company/*?

# Disallow admin areas
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /admin-v2/
Disallow: /admanager/
Disallow: /temp/
Disallow: /dbconfig/
Disallow: /dbscripts/
Disallow: /cache/
Disallow: /cachemanager/
Disallow: /uploads/
Disallow: /scripts/

# Disallow API endpoints that shouldn't be indexed
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /webconfig/

# Disallow test files
Disallow: /test-*.php
Disallow: /test-*.html

# Disallow cache and temporary files
Disallow: /cache-manager.php
Disallow: /cache-manifest/

# Disallow sensitive configuration files
Disallow: /*.conf
Disallow: /*.ini
Disallow: /.htaccess
Disallow: /.git/

# Allow specific file types
Allow: /*.css$
Allow: /*.js$
Allow: /*.png$
Allow: /*.jpg$
Allow: /*.jpeg$
Allow: /*.gif$
Allow: /*.svg$
Allow: /*.ico$

# Sitemap location (same canonical host family as public pages)
Sitemap: https://www.sacnilk.com/sitemap-index.xml

    // feedback form shows "Feedback about this page" and sends it as url/title. pages/feedback.php reads and clears it.
    window.setFeedbackSource = function () {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem("feedbackSourceUrl", location.href);
            localStorage.setItem("feedbackSourceTitle", document.title);
            localStorage.setItem("feedbackSourceAt", String(Date.now()));
        } catch (e) {}
    };
    
    
   
    // What the page knows about the visitor, and everything that follows from it
    function applyUserData(userData) {
        window.isLoggedIn = userData.isLoggedIn;
        window.userName = userData.userName;
        window.userLevel = userData.userLevel;
        window.userId = userData.userId;

        // Update UI if function exists
        if (typeof updateUserInterface === 'function') {
            updateUserInterface();
        }
        // For widgets on cached pages that depend on who is looking (movie rating)
        window.sacnilkUser = userData;
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sacnilk:user', { detail: userData }));
    }

    // sn_li=1 is set at login and cleared at logout (webconfig/session-bootstrap.php). Without it nobody is logged
    // in here, and the page says so itself, with the same answer api/user-data.php gives a visitor with no session.
    function mayBeLoggedIn() {
        return /(?:^|;\s*)sn_li=1(?:;|$)/.test(document.cookie);
    }
    // My Sacnilk, the personal layer of a logged-in reader (assets/js/sn-me.js). This page is the same stored copy
    // for everyone, so the layer is loaded only for a browser that carries the login hint; nobody else downloads it.
    // The classes go on <html> here, before first paint: sn-li = may be logged in, sn-me-on = this browser had the
    // layer on its last page (so the home page keeps room for "My Films" and does not jump).
    (function () {
        var de = document.documentElement;
        de.classList.add('sn-follow-on');   // the Follow buttons are shown to every reader
        if (mayBeLoggedIn()) {
            de.classList.add('sn-li');
            try { if (localStorage.getItem('sn-me') === '1') { de.classList.add('sn-me-on'); } } catch (e) {}
            var css = document.createElement('link');
            css.rel = 'stylesheet';
            css.href = "/assets/css/sn-me.css?v=1795433007";
            var js = document.createElement('script');
            js.src = "/assets/js/sn-me.js?v=1795433010";
            js.defer = true;
            document.head.appendChild(css);
            document.head.appendChild(js);
            return;
        }
        // A logged-out tap on a Follow or "+ My Hero" button: remember the film (or the person), log in, and come back
        // to this page following it (sn-me.js completes the follow once the reader is back and logged in).
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-follow-film], [data-follow-person]') : null;
            if (!b) { return; }
            e.preventDefault();
            var person = b.hasAttribute('data-follow-person');
            try { sessionStorage.setItem(person ? 'sn-hero-pending' : 'sn-follow-pending', JSON.stringify({ id: b.getAttribute(person ? 'data-follow-person' : 'data-follow-film'), t: Date.now() })); } catch (err) {}
            var base = window.sacnilk.base_path || '', path = location.pathname;
            if (base && path.indexOf(base + '/') === 0) { path = path.slice(base.length); }
            window.location.href = base + '/login?redirect=' + encodeURIComponent(path + location.search);
        });
    })();
    function loadUserDataIfLoggedIn() {
        if (mayBeLoggedIn()) {
            return loadUserData();
        }
        applyUserData({ isLoggedIn: false, userName: '', userLevel: 1, userId: '', timestamp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) });
    }

    // Load user data dynamically
    // fresh === true (after a login on this page, e.g. the rating widget): bypass the 60 s browser copy of the
    // logged-out answer
    async function loadUserData(fresh) {
        try {
            let apiUrl = '/api/user-data.php';
            if(window.location.hostname === 'localhost') {
                apiUrl = '/sacweb/api/user-data.php';
            }
            const response = fresh === true
                ? await fetch(apiUrl + '?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'same-origin' })
                : await fetch(apiUrl);
            const result = await response.json();
            
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                // Not logged in after all (expired, or logged out elsewhere): drop the hint, so the next page asks nothing
                if (!result.data.isLoggedIn) {
                    document.cookie = 'sn_li=; Max-Age=0; path=/';
                }
                applyUserData(result.data);
                //console.log('User data loaded:', userData);
            } else {
                console.warn('Failed to load user data:', result.message);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to load user data:', error);
        }
    }
    
    // Load on page load, for a visitor who may be logged in
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadUserDataIfLoggedIn);
    window.sacnilkReloadUser = function () { return loadUserData(true); };
    // A page restored from the back/forward cache keeps the login state it was first drawn with: refresh it
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (e) { if (e.persisted) { loadUserDataIfLoggedIn(); } });

    <script>
        // Function to update user interface based on login status
        function updateUserInterface() {
            const userAccountMenu = document.getElementById('userAccountMenu');
            const loginButton = document.getElementById('loginButton');
            const mobileUserAccount = document.getElementById('mobileUserAccount');
            const mobileLoginButton = document.getElementById('mobileLoginButton');
            const userInitial = document.getElementById('userInitial');
            const mobileUserInitial = document.getElementById('mobileUserInitial');
            
            if (window.isLoggedIn) {
                // Show user account menu, hide login button
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'block';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'none';
                
                // Update user initials
                if (userInitial && window.userName) {
                    userInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }
                if (mobileUserInitial && window.userName) {
                    mobileUserInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }

                // Role-based menu links. Levels: 8 = admin, 9 = super admin, 20 = subscriber (Pro).
                // The real access check is enforced server-side; this only controls link visibility.
                var lvl = parseInt(window.userLevel, 10);
                var isAdmin = (lvl === 8 || lvl === 9);
                var isPro = (lvl === 20 || isAdmin);

                var adminMenuLink = document.getElementById('adminMenuLink');
                if (adminMenuLink) adminMenuLink.style.display = isAdmin ? 'flex' : 'none';

                var proDashboardLink = document.getElementById('proDashboardLink');
                if (proDashboardLink) proDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
                var mobileProDashboardLink = document.getElementById('mobileProDashboardLink');
                if (mobileProDashboardLink) mobileProDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
            } else {
                // Show login button, hide user account menu
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'none';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
        
        // Update interface when page loads
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            updateUserInterface();
        });


        // Fix desktop submenu hover stability with precise targeting
        function initializeDesktopSubmenuFix() {
            // Only apply on desktop
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                const menuGroups = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
                
                menuGroups.forEach(group => {
                    const menuButton = group.querySelector('button');
                    const submenu = group.querySelector('.absolute.group-hover\\:opacity-100');
                    
                    if (menuButton && submenu) {
                        let hoverTimeout;
                        let isHovering = false;
                        
                        // More precise hover detection - only on button
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                            submenu.classList.add('js-controlled');
                        });
                        
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                            // Check if mouse is moving to submenu
                            const rect = submenu.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const mouseX = e.clientX;
                            const mouseY = e.clientY;
                            
                            // If mouse is within submenu bounds, don't hide
                            if (mouseX >= rect.left && mouseX <= rect.right && 
                                mouseY >= rect.top && mouseY <= rect.bottom) {
                                return;
                            }
                            
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                if (!isHovering) {
                                    submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                                }
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Keep submenu open when hovering over it
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                        });
                        
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Ensure submenu can receive mouse events when shown
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            submenu.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // Check visibility on load and resize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            initializeDesktopSubmenuFix();
        });


    </script>

    <script>
        // Function to update user interface based on login status
        function updateUserInterface() {
            const userAccountMenu = document.getElementById('userAccountMenu');
            const loginButton = document.getElementById('loginButton');
            const mobileUserAccount = document.getElementById('mobileUserAccount');
            const mobileLoginButton = document.getElementById('mobileLoginButton');
            const userInitial = document.getElementById('userInitial');
            const mobileUserInitial = document.getElementById('mobileUserInitial');
            
            if (window.isLoggedIn) {
                // Show user account menu, hide login button
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'block';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'none';
                
                // Update user initials
                if (userInitial && window.userName) {
                    userInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }
                if (mobileUserInitial && window.userName) {
                    mobileUserInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }

                // Role-based menu links. Levels: 8 = admin, 9 = super admin, 20 = subscriber (Pro).
                // The real access check is enforced server-side; this only controls link visibility.
                var lvl = parseInt(window.userLevel, 10);
                var isAdmin = (lvl === 8 || lvl === 9);
                var isPro = (lvl === 20 || isAdmin);

                var adminMenuLink = document.getElementById('adminMenuLink');
                if (adminMenuLink) adminMenuLink.style.display = isAdmin ? 'flex' : 'none';

                var proDashboardLink = document.getElementById('proDashboardLink');
                if (proDashboardLink) proDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
                var mobileProDashboardLink = document.getElementById('mobileProDashboardLink');
                if (mobileProDashboardLink) mobileProDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
            } else {
                // Show login button, hide user account menu
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'none';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
        
        // Update interface when page loads
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            updateUserInterface();
        });


        // Fix desktop submenu hover stability with precise targeting
        function initializeDesktopSubmenuFix() {
            // Only apply on desktop
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                const menuGroups = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
                
                menuGroups.forEach(group => {
                    const menuButton = group.querySelector('button');
                    const submenu = group.querySelector('.absolute.group-hover\\:opacity-100');
                    
                    if (menuButton && submenu) {
                        let hoverTimeout;
                        let isHovering = false;
                        
                        // More precise hover detection - only on button
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                            submenu.classList.add('js-controlled');
                        });
                        
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                            // Check if mouse is moving to submenu
                            const rect = submenu.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const mouseX = e.clientX;
                            const mouseY = e.clientY;
                            
                            // If mouse is within submenu bounds, don't hide
                            if (mouseX >= rect.left && mouseX <= rect.right && 
                                mouseY >= rect.top && mouseY <= rect.bottom) {
                                return;
                            }
                            
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                if (!isHovering) {
                                    submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                                }
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Keep submenu open when hovering over it
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                        });
                        
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Ensure submenu can receive mouse events when shown
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            submenu.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // Check visibility on load and resize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            initializeDesktopSubmenuFix();
        });


    </script>

    function mayBeLoggedIn() {

            if(window.location.hostname === 'localhost') {
                apiUrl = '/sacweb/api/user-data.php';
            }
            const response = fresh === true
                ? await fetch(apiUrl + '?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'same-origin' })
                : await fetch(apiUrl);

        // Function to update user interface based on login status
        function updateUserInterface() {
            const userAccountMenu = document.getElementById('userAccountMenu');
            const loginButton = document.getElementById('loginButton');
            const mobileUserAccount = document.getElementById('mobileUserAccount');
            const mobileLoginButton = document.getElementById('mobileLoginButton');
            const userInitial = document.getElementById('userInitial');
            const mobileUserInitial = document.getElementById('mobileUserInitial');
            
            if (window.isLoggedIn) {
                // Show user account menu, hide login button
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'block';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'none';
                
                // Update user initials
                if (userInitial && window.userName) {
                    userInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }
                if (mobileUserInitial && window.userName) {
                    mobileUserInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }

                // Role-based menu links. Levels: 8 = admin, 9 = super admin, 20 = subscriber (Pro).
                // The real access check is enforced server-side; this only controls link visibility.
                var lvl = parseInt(window.userLevel, 10);
                var isAdmin = (lvl === 8 || lvl === 9);
                var isPro = (lvl === 20 || isAdmin);

                var adminMenuLink = document.getElementById('adminMenuLink');
                if (adminMenuLink) adminMenuLink.style.display = isAdmin ? 'flex' : 'none';

                var proDashboardLink = document.getElementById('proDashboardLink');
                if (proDashboardLink) proDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
                var mobileProDashboardLink = document.getElementById('mobileProDashboardLink');
                if (mobileProDashboardLink) mobileProDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
            } else {
                // Show login button, hide user account menu
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'none';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
        
        // Update interface when page loads
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            updateUserInterface();
        });


        // Fix desktop submenu hover stability with precise targeting
        function initializeDesktopSubmenuFix() {
            // Only apply on desktop
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                const menuGroups = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
                
                menuGroups.forEach(group => {
                    const menuButton = group.querySelector('button');
                    const submenu = group.querySelector('.absolute.group-hover\\:opacity-100');
                    
                    if (menuButton && submenu) {
                        let hoverTimeout;
                        let isHovering = false;
                        
                        // More precise hover detection - only on button
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                            submenu.classList.add('js-controlled');
                        });
                        
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                            // Check if mouse is moving to submenu
                            const rect = submenu.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const mouseX = e.clientX;
                            const mouseY = e.clientY;
                            
                            // If mouse is within submenu bounds, don't hide
                            if (mouseX >= rect.left && mouseX <= rect.right && 
                                mouseY >= rect.top && mouseY <= rect.bottom) {
                                return;
                            }
                            
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                if (!isHovering) {
                                    submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                                }
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Keep submenu open when hovering over it
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                        });
                        
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Ensure submenu can receive mouse events when shown
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            submenu.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // Check visibility on load and resize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            initializeDesktopSubmenuFix();
        });


    </script>

<script>
    // Hero slider. The active dot's pill is the timer: a CSS animation fills it over the slide's time (--lvh-ms)
    // and its animationend moves to the next slide. Pausing is pausing that animation, so the fill freezes where it
    // is and carries on from there; there is no JS timer to keep in step with it.
    const heroEl = document.querySelector('.lvh');
    const carouselContainer = document.getElementById('carousel-container');
    const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.hero-carousel-dot, .hero-carousel-dot-mobile');
    const totalSlides = 11;
    const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const pauseReasons = new Set();   // hover | focus | touch | hidden | manual: paused while any of them holds
    let currentSlide = 0;

    function updateCarousel() {
        if (currentSlide >= totalSlides) currentSlide = 0;
        const slideWidth = 100 / totalSlides;
        const translateX = -currentSlide * slideWidth;
        carouselContainer.style.transform = `translateX(${translateX}%)`;

        // Update dots
        dots.forEach((dot, index) => {
            const slideIdx = parseInt(dot.getAttribute('data-slide'));
            const targetIdx = !isNaN(slideIdx) ? slideIdx : (index % totalSlides);
            if (targetIdx === currentSlide) {
                dot.classList.add('bg-opacity-100');
                dot.classList.remove('bg-opacity-60');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
            } else {
                dot.classList.add('bg-opacity-60');
                dot.classList.remove('bg-opacity-100');
                dot.removeAttribute('aria-current');
            }
        });
    }

    // Start the active pill's fill again from zero (a dot click or a swipe, also onto the slide already in view)
    function restartFill() {
        const fill = heroEl.querySelector('.bg-opacity-100 .lvh-fill');
        if (!fill) return;
        fill.style.setProperty('animation-name', 'none', 'important');   // the sheet's own is !important
        void fill.offsetWidth;
        fill.style.removeProperty('animation-name');
    }

    function goToSlide(slideIndex) {
        currentSlide = ((slideIndex % totalSlides) + totalSlides) % totalSlides;
        updateCarousel();
        restartFill();
    }

    function nextSlide() { goToSlide(currentSlide + 1); }
    function prevSlide() { goToSlide(currentSlide - 1); }

    function setPaused(reason, on) {
        if (on) { pauseReasons.add(reason); } else { pauseReasons.delete(reason); }
        heroEl.classList.toggle('is-paused', pauseReasons.size > 0);
    }

    // No auto-advance and no fill animation for one slide, or for a reader who asked for reduced motion: without
    // .lvh-auto the pill is a plain full one and nothing ends, so nothing moves. The dots still work.
    function applyAuto() {
        heroEl.classList.toggle('lvh-auto', totalSlides > 1 && !reducedMotion.matches);
    }

    function showPlayPause() {
        const paused = pauseReasons.has('manual');
        document.querySelectorAll('.pause-icon-el').forEach(el => { el.classList.toggle('hidden', paused); el.style.display = paused ? 'none' : 'block'; });
        document.querySelectorAll('.play-icon-el').forEach(el => { el.classList.toggle('hidden', !paused); el.style.display = paused ? 'block' : 'none'; });
        document.querySelectorAll('.play-pause-btn').forEach(btn => btn.setAttribute('aria-label', paused ? 'Play Carousel' : 'Pause Carousel'));
    }

    if (heroEl && carouselContainer) {
        // A slide image that is not 16:9 is shown whole over a blurred copy of itself (assets/css/live.css): mark
        // its box and hand the style the address the browser actually loaded (a fallback's, if it came to that).
        heroEl.querySelectorAll('.lvh-img img').forEach((img) => {
            const mark = () => {
                const box = img.closest('.lvh-img');
                if (!box || !img.naturalWidth || !img.naturalHeight) return;
                const off = Math.abs(img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight - 16 / 9) > 0.03;
                if (off) { box.style.setProperty('--lvh-bg', 'url("' + (img.currentSrc || img.src).replace(/"/g, '%22') + '")'); }
                box.classList.toggle('has-bg', off);
            };
            img.addEventListener('load', mark);
            if (img.complete) mark();
        });

        // The fill reaching the end is the slide's time being up
        heroEl.addEventListener('animationend', (e) => {
            if (e.animationName === 'lvh-fill') { nextSlide(); }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.play-pause-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent other click handlers and link navigation
                setPaused('manual', !pauseReasons.has('manual'));
                showPlayPause();
            });
        });

        // Dot navigation
        dots.forEach((dot, index) => {
            dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                goToSlide(parseInt(dot.getAttribute('data-slide') || index));
            });
        });

        // Pause while a mouse is over the hero, and while keyboard focus is inside it. A tap also sends pointerenter,
        // with no leave to follow, so only a mouse counts; a mouse click on a dot leaves focus on it, so only focus
        // the browser shows a ring for counts.
        heroEl.addEventListener('pointerenter', (e) => { if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') setPaused('hover', true); });
        heroEl.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => setPaused('hover', false));
        heroEl.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
            let visible = true;
            try { visible = e.target.matches(':focus-visible'); } catch (err) {}
            if (visible) setPaused('focus', true);
        });
        heroEl.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
            if (!heroEl.contains(e.relatedTarget)) setPaused('focus', false);
        });

        // Not while the tab is hidden
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => setPaused('hidden', document.hidden));
        setPaused('hidden', document.hidden);

        // Touch/swipe: the fill holds while a finger is down; a swipe moves a slide and starts its fill from zero
        let startX = 0;
        heroEl.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
            startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            setPaused('touch', true);
        }, { passive: true }); // passive for better performance
        heroEl.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
            const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
            if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) { if (diff > 0) { nextSlide(); } else { prevSlide(); } }
            setPaused('touch', false);
        });
        heroEl.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => setPaused('touch', false));

        if (reducedMotion.addEventListener) { reducedMotion.addEventListener('change', applyAuto); }
        else if (reducedMotion.addListener) { reducedMotion.addListener(applyAuto); }

        // Initialize carousel
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            updateCarousel();
            // Add a small delay to ensure DOM is fully painted before starting animation
            setTimeout(applyAuto, 100);
        });

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            updateCarousel();
        });
    }


    // Animation observer
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
                    entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.slide-up').forEach(el => {
            el.style.opacity = '0';
            el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    });

                        <h3 class="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg mb-3 leading-tight hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors line-clamp-2">
                            Upfront fee or profit share? How actors can compare two very different film deals                        </h3>
                        
                        <div class="text-gray-600 text-sm mb-4 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">
                            A ₹40 crore salary and a share of profits may look easy to compare, but payment timing, contract language, and the risk of a weak theatrical run can change which offer is actually worth more.
An actor walks into a negotiation with two offers on the table. One promises ₹20 crore on a fixed schedule. The other offers less cash upfront but a percentage of the film&rsquo;s profits, carrying the possibility of a much larger payday. The second figure will usually make the louder headline, yet the quieter offer may leave the actor in a stronger financial position.
Indian cinema already produces several versions of the fixed-fee-plus-backend model. As we reported, Yash&rsquo;s reported Toxic deal combined a ₹50 crore fee with 60% of net profits after the makers recovered their initial investment. The reported arrangement is a hybrid deal: guaranteed remuneration protects part of the actor&rsquo;s earnings, while the profit share preserves the upside if theatrical and ancillary revenue lifts the film into profit.
The headline number hides the contract
A fixed fee is easier to understand because the contract states how much the actor receives and when the instalments become due. Even then, the full amount may not arrive on signing day. Payments can be tied to the start of filming, the completion of a schedule, dubbing, or delivery, so a quoted ₹20 crore fee may be paid to the actor over many months.
Profit participation brings a different set of questions. Does the percentage apply to gross revenue, the producer&rsquo;s share, or net profit? Which production, marketing, distribution, and financing costs come out first? Can an actor inspect the accounts? A generous percentage attached to a narrow definition of profit can produce a smaller cheque than the headline suggests.
Reported remuneration figures also need caution. In our coverage of Akshay Kumar&rsquo;s Golmaal 5 remuneration rumours, the production house dismissed the circulated numbers as baseless and said the commercial terms were confidential. Film contracts rarely become public in full, which means readers often compare fragments rather than the actual agreements.
Cash today and money after release
Payment timing changes the comparison even when both figures are accurate. Suppose one offer guarantees ₹20 crore now, while another is expected to pay ₹30 crore three years after release. At an assumed annual return of 8%, that future ₹30 crore has a present value of about ₹23.81 crore. A present value calculator can perform the same comparison for a single expected future payment by using the future amount, the number of periods, and an interest rate that serves as the discount rate.&nbsp;
The ₹23.81 crore estimate still does not make the deferred deal automatically better. The calculation assumes the ₹30 crore arrives as expected. A delayed release, rising costs, a weak theatrical run, or a dispute over the definition of profit can reduce the payment or push it further into the future. Where a contract contains several expected payments on different dates, each cash flow needs separate treatment rather than being folded into a single headline number.
What guaranteed money can earn elsewhere
Guaranteed money has an opportunity cost as well. An actor who receives a fee earlier can use it for another production, property, debt reduction, or a diversified investment portfolio. SEBI&rsquo;s investor education material notes that shareholders may receive part of a company&rsquo;s profit as a dividend, although the company decides whether to distribute that money.
For a simple illustration, imagine that ₹20 crore is invested in dividend-paying shares with an assumed 6% annual yield, and all dividends are reinvested. After five years, the model produces about ₹26.76 crore before taxes, fees, and changes in the share price or dividend. A dividend calculator can estimate the yield, final balance, growth, and dividend profit from the share price, annual dividend per share, amount invested, time period, and reinvestment frequency. It is a scenario, not a forecast.
The safest-looking contract can still disappoint, and the boldest backend deal can become a career-defining payday. Much depends on the star&rsquo;s bargaining power, confidence in the film, need for immediate liquidity, and access to reliable accounting. A hybrid agreement often sits between those extremes by putting some money in the bank while leaving a portion of the actor&rsquo;s earnings tied to the film&rsquo;s commercial run.
By the time the first Friday arrives, the two offers no longer look like ₹20 crore versus ₹30 crore. One has already started working for the actor; the other is still waiting on ticket sales, rights revenue, deductions, and the wording buried in the signed contract.                        </div>

                        <h3 class="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg mb-3 leading-tight hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors line-clamp-2">

                        <div class="text-gray-600 text-sm mb-4 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">
                            Celebrations in Dubai often involve careful planning. A birthday dinner may be booked weeks ahead, a hotel room may be prepared for a surprise, or a family gathering may be arranged around several busy schedules. Flowers have become part of that planning because they can reach the recipient even when the sender cannot be there in person.
The growing use of flower delivery in Dubai has made these gestures easier to organise. A bouquet can be sent to an office, apartment, hotel, or restaurant with a message attached, giving people more freedom to celebrate across different parts of the city.
This has changed the role of flowers. They are still associated with major occasions, but they are also being used for smaller, more personal moments that might once have passed without any formal gift.
Celebrations No Longer Depend on Everyone Being in the Same Place
Dubai is home to people from many countries, and families are often spread across several cities. A parent may live in India, a close friend may be travelling in Europe, and a sibling may be working in another emirate.
In the past, distance could make a celebration feel incomplete. Today, sending flowers offers a simple way to take part in the occasion from elsewhere.
The sender can arrange the bouquet before the event and add a personal message. The recipient still has something physical to open, display, and remember after the phone calls and video messages are over.
This is especially common for:


birthdays;


anniversaries;


engagements;


graduations;


promotions;


new babies;


housewarmings.


The delivery becomes one part of the celebration rather than a replacement for it.
Smaller Moments Are Receiving More Attention
Flowers used to be closely linked with formal dates. People still order them for weddings, Valentine&rsquo;s Day, and anniversaries, although many deliveries now mark ordinary achievements or difficult weeks.
A friend may send flowers after someone finishes an important project. A colleague may arrange a bouquet for a team member returning from leave. Relatives may send an arrangement to a couple who have just moved into a new home.
These occasions do not always appear on a calendar. They happen during everyday life, which is why convenient ordering matters.
A Gift Does Not Need a Major Reason
Some of the most appreciated deliveries come without a large event attached to them. A short note saying &ldquo;thinking of you&rdquo; can suit someone who is recovering at home or dealing with a stressful period.
Flowers also work well as a delayed thank-you. After a dinner, family visit, or favour, a bouquet can be sent the following day without creating the pressure of choosing a formal gift in advance.
Dubai&rsquo;s Venues Have Changed How Flowers Are Delivered
The city offers a wide range of places to celebrate, from private villas and rooftop restaurants to beach clubs and hotel suites. Each location creates different delivery requirements.
A bouquet going to a restaurant may need to arrive before the guests. A hotel delivery usually requires the recipient&rsquo;s booking name and a contact number. Office buildings often ask couriers to leave items at reception.
For home deliveries, the sender may need to provide a villa number, tower name, or additional directions.
Information That Helps Avoid Delays
Before placing an order, it is useful to confirm:


the full delivery address;


the recipient&rsquo;s local phone number;


the venue or building name;


the expected time of arrival;


whether reception can accept the arrangement.


These details may seem minor, yet they can determine whether the surprise runs smoothly.
Personalisation Has Become Easier
Choosing flowers online gives senders more control over the appearance of the gift. They can compare colours, arrangement styles, and sizes instead of relying on a verbal description.
This is useful when the sender knows the recipient&rsquo;s taste. Someone who likes simple interiors may prefer a restrained arrangement with white flowers and greenery. A person who enjoys bold colours may appreciate something brighter.
The container also matters. A bouquet wrapped in paper works well when the recipient is at home and has a vase. A boxed or vase arrangement can be more convenient in an office or hotel room.
The Message Often Makes the Difference
A short message helps the bouquet feel connected to the occasion.
The best notes are usually specific. &ldquo;Congratulations on the new role&rdquo; says more than a general greeting. For a birthday, a private joke or shared memory can make the card feel much warmer.
There is little need for formal language. A natural sentence is usually enough.
Flowers Are Playing a Larger Role in Professional Celebrations
Dubai&rsquo;s business culture creates many occasions for corporate gifting. Flowers are sent for office openings, promotions, project launches, and client milestones.
They can also be used to welcome a visiting executive or thank a partner after an event.
Professional arrangements tend to be cleaner in style. Neutral colours and ready-to-display designs are often easier to manage in an office. The card should state the reason clearly and include the sender&rsquo;s name or company.
It is worth checking the workplace delivery policy in advance. Some office towers require couriers to contact reception, while others may restrict deliveries to certain hours.
Timing Has Become More Precise
The emotional effect of a bouquet often depends on when it arrives.
Flowers delivered before a birthday dinner can become part of the table setting. An arrangement waiting in a hotel room creates a different experience from one that arrives after the guest has checked out.
For proposals, anniversaries, and organised surprises, timing deserves particular attention. The sender should consider when the recipient will be available and whether the location can hold the flowers safely.
Advance orders usually provide more flexibility. They allow time to choose the arrangement and confirm the delivery details. Last-minute orders remain useful, although the available selection may be narrower.
Freshness Still Determines the Final Impression
The design of the bouquet matters, but the condition of the flowers is easy to notice.
Strong stems, clean leaves, and healthy petals make the arrangement look properly prepared. In Dubai&rsquo;s climate, careful transport is particularly important because heat can affect flowers quickly.
Once the bouquet arrives, the recipient can help it last longer by following a few basic steps:


Place loose stems in a clean vase.


Trim the ends before adding water.


Remove leaves below the waterline.


Keep the flowers away from direct sunlight.


Replace the water regularly.


Boxed arrangements and flowers placed in floral foam also need moisture, although water should be added carefully.
Celebration Is Becoming More Flexible
Flower delivery has made it easier to celebrate at a distance, arrange surprises around busy schedules, and acknowledge occasions that do not require a large event.
People can send something personal without needing to visit a shop or coordinate an in-person handover. At the same time, the recipient still receives a physical gift that can be displayed and enjoyed after the celebration.
In a city where people often balance work, travel, and family across several locations, that flexibility has become useful. Flowers now fit into celebrations of many sizes, from major milestones to an ordinary day that someone decided was worth marking.                        </div>

The German context
The design recognition lands in ELFBAR's largest European market. According to internal data, the brand leads the German pod system category with about 60 percent market share. Prefilled and refillable products &mdash; including the ELFX and ELFA pod systems and the ELFLIQ e-liquid range &mdash; now account for around 80 percent of the company's shipments to Germany. Single-use formats, once a defining part of the category, no longer drive the brand's German business.
European regulators have meanwhile sharpened their focus on disposable vapes and on packaging waste. Brands that can demonstrate genuine reusability, supported by replaceable components and durable design, are increasingly being separated from those that cannot. The awarded ELFX and ELFA products are positioned within that shift.
What comes next
ELFBAR said it plans to introduce the award-winning ELFX and ELFA designs to other European markets in due course, with the ELFX 2 leading the next wave from Germany in June 2026. Specific dates, pricing and channel availability will be confirmed market by market.

    // the theme this page opened in and the rule that picked it (components/ThemeMode.php), on the page view and the

    window.setFeedbackSource = function () {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem("feedbackSourceUrl", location.href);
            localStorage.setItem("feedbackSourceTitle", document.title);
            localStorage.setItem("feedbackSourceAt", String(Date.now()));
        } catch (e) {}

    // What the page knows about the visitor, and everything that follows from it
    function applyUserData(userData) {
        window.isLoggedIn = userData.isLoggedIn;
        window.userName = userData.userName;
        window.userLevel = userData.userLevel;
        window.userId = userData.userId;

        // Update UI if function exists
        if (typeof updateUserInterface === 'function') {
            updateUserInterface();
        }
        // For widgets on cached pages that depend on who is looking (movie rating)
        window.sacnilkUser = userData;
        document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sacnilk:user', { detail: userData }));
    }

    // sn_li=1 is set at login and cleared at logout (webconfig/session-bootstrap.php). Without it nobody is logged
    // in here, and the page says so itself, with the same answer api/user-data.php gives a visitor with no session.
    function mayBeLoggedIn() {
        return /(?:^|;\s*)sn_li=1(?:;|$)/.test(document.cookie);
    }
    // My Sacnilk, the personal layer of a logged-in reader (assets/js/sn-me.js). This page is the same stored copy
    // for everyone, so the layer is loaded only for a browser that carries the login hint; nobody else downloads it.
    // The classes go on <html> here, before first paint: sn-li = may be logged in, sn-me-on = this browser had the
    // layer on its last page (so the home page keeps room for "My Films" and does not jump).
    (function () {
        var de = document.documentElement;
        de.classList.add('sn-follow-on');   // the Follow buttons are shown to every reader
        if (mayBeLoggedIn()) {
            de.classList.add('sn-li');
            try { if (localStorage.getItem('sn-me') === '1') { de.classList.add('sn-me-on'); } } catch (e) {}
            var css = document.createElement('link');
            css.rel = 'stylesheet';
            css.href = "/assets/css/sn-me.css?v=1795433007";
            var js = document.createElement('script');
            js.src = "/assets/js/sn-me.js?v=1795433010";
            js.defer = true;
            document.head.appendChild(css);
            document.head.appendChild(js);
            return;
        }
        // A logged-out tap on a Follow or "+ My Hero" button: remember the film (or the person), log in, and come back
        // to this page following it (sn-me.js completes the follow once the reader is back and logged in).
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var b = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-follow-film], [data-follow-person]') : null;
            if (!b) { return; }
            e.preventDefault();
            var person = b.hasAttribute('data-follow-person');
            try { sessionStorage.setItem(person ? 'sn-hero-pending' : 'sn-follow-pending', JSON.stringify({ id: b.getAttribute(person ? 'data-follow-person' : 'data-follow-film'), t: Date.now() })); } catch (err) {}
            var base = window.sacnilk.base_path || '', path = location.pathname;
            if (base && path.indexOf(base + '/') === 0) { path = path.slice(base.length); }
            window.location.href = base + '/login?redirect=' + encodeURIComponent(path + location.search);
        });
    })();
    function loadUserDataIfLoggedIn() {
        if (mayBeLoggedIn()) {
            return loadUserData();
        }
        applyUserData({ isLoggedIn: false, userName: '', userLevel: 1, userId: '', timestamp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) });
    }

    // Load user data dynamically
    // fresh === true (after a login on this page, e.g. the rating widget): bypass the 60 s browser copy of the
    // logged-out answer
    async function loadUserData(fresh) {
        try {
            let apiUrl = '/api/user-data.php';
            if(window.location.hostname === 'localhost') {
                apiUrl = '/sacweb/api/user-data.php';
            }
            const response = fresh === true
                ? await fetch(apiUrl + '?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'same-origin' })
                : await fetch(apiUrl);
            const result = await response.json();
            
            if (result.success && result.data) {
                // Not logged in after all (expired, or logged out elsewhere): drop the hint, so the next page asks nothing
                if (!result.data.isLoggedIn) {
                    document.cookie = 'sn_li=; Max-Age=0; path=/';
                }
                applyUserData(result.data);
                //console.log('User data loaded:', userData);
            } else {
                console.warn('Failed to load user data:', result.message);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to load user data:', error);
        }
    }
    
    // Load on page load, for a visitor who may be logged in
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadUserDataIfLoggedIn);
    window.sacnilkReloadUser = function () { return loadUserData(true); };
    // A page restored from the back/forward cache keeps the login state it was first drawn with: refresh it
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (e) { if (e.persisted) { loadUserDataIfLoggedIn(); } });

    <!-- User Authentication JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Function to update user interface based on login status
        function updateUserInterface() {
            const userAccountMenu = document.getElementById('userAccountMenu');
            const loginButton = document.getElementById('loginButton');
            const mobileUserAccount = document.getElementById('mobileUserAccount');
            const mobileLoginButton = document.getElementById('mobileLoginButton');
            const userInitial = document.getElementById('userInitial');
            const mobileUserInitial = document.getElementById('mobileUserInitial');
            
            if (window.isLoggedIn) {
                // Show user account menu, hide login button
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'block';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'none';
                
                // Update user initials
                if (userInitial && window.userName) {
                    userInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }
                if (mobileUserInitial && window.userName) {
                    mobileUserInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }

                // Role-based menu links. Levels: 8 = admin, 9 = super admin, 20 = subscriber (Pro).
                // The real access check is enforced server-side; this only controls link visibility.
                var lvl = parseInt(window.userLevel, 10);
                var isAdmin = (lvl === 8 || lvl === 9);
                var isPro = (lvl === 20 || isAdmin);

                var adminMenuLink = document.getElementById('adminMenuLink');
                if (adminMenuLink) adminMenuLink.style.display = isAdmin ? 'flex' : 'none';

                var proDashboardLink = document.getElementById('proDashboardLink');
                if (proDashboardLink) proDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
                var mobileProDashboardLink = document.getElementById('mobileProDashboardLink');
                if (mobileProDashboardLink) mobileProDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
            } else {
                // Show login button, hide user account menu
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'none';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
        
        // Update interface when page loads
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            updateUserInterface();
        });


        // Fix desktop submenu hover stability with precise targeting
        function initializeDesktopSubmenuFix() {
            // Only apply on desktop
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                const menuGroups = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
                
                menuGroups.forEach(group => {
                    const menuButton = group.querySelector('button');
                    const submenu = group.querySelector('.absolute.group-hover\\:opacity-100');
                    
                    if (menuButton && submenu) {
                        let hoverTimeout;
                        let isHovering = false;
                        
                        // More precise hover detection - only on button
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                            submenu.classList.add('js-controlled');
                        });
                        
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                            // Check if mouse is moving to submenu
                            const rect = submenu.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const mouseX = e.clientX;
                            const mouseY = e.clientY;
                            
                            // If mouse is within submenu bounds, don't hide
                            if (mouseX >= rect.left && mouseX <= rect.right && 
                                mouseY >= rect.top && mouseY <= rect.bottom) {
                                return;
                            }
                            
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                if (!isHovering) {
                                    submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                                }
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Keep submenu open when hovering over it
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                        });
                        
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Ensure submenu can receive mouse events when shown
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            submenu.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            initializeDesktopSubmenuFix();

    <!-- User Authentication JavaScript -->
    <script>
        // Function to update user interface based on login status
        function updateUserInterface() {
            const userAccountMenu = document.getElementById('userAccountMenu');
            const loginButton = document.getElementById('loginButton');
            const mobileUserAccount = document.getElementById('mobileUserAccount');
            const mobileLoginButton = document.getElementById('mobileLoginButton');
            const userInitial = document.getElementById('userInitial');
            const mobileUserInitial = document.getElementById('mobileUserInitial');
            
            if (window.isLoggedIn) {
                // Show user account menu, hide login button
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'block';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'none';
                
                // Update user initials
                if (userInitial && window.userName) {
                    userInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }
                if (mobileUserInitial && window.userName) {
                    mobileUserInitial.textContent = window.userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                }

                // Role-based menu links. Levels: 8 = admin, 9 = super admin, 20 = subscriber (Pro).
                // The real access check is enforced server-side; this only controls link visibility.
                var lvl = parseInt(window.userLevel, 10);
                var isAdmin = (lvl === 8 || lvl === 9);
                var isPro = (lvl === 20 || isAdmin);

                var adminMenuLink = document.getElementById('adminMenuLink');
                if (adminMenuLink) adminMenuLink.style.display = isAdmin ? 'flex' : 'none';

                var proDashboardLink = document.getElementById('proDashboardLink');
                if (proDashboardLink) proDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
                var mobileProDashboardLink = document.getElementById('mobileProDashboardLink');
                if (mobileProDashboardLink) mobileProDashboardLink.style.display = isPro ? 'flex' : 'none';
            } else {
                // Show login button, hide user account menu
                if (userAccountMenu) userAccountMenu.style.display = 'none';
                if (loginButton) loginButton.style.display = 'block';
                if (mobileUserAccount) mobileUserAccount.style.display = 'none';
                if (mobileLoginButton) mobileLoginButton.style.display = 'block';
            }
        }
        
        // Update interface when page loads
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            updateUserInterface();
        });


        // Fix desktop submenu hover stability with precise targeting
        function initializeDesktopSubmenuFix() {
            // Only apply on desktop
            if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
                const menuGroups = document.querySelectorAll('.group');
                
                menuGroups.forEach(group => {
                    const menuButton = group.querySelector('button');
                    const submenu = group.querySelector('.absolute.group-hover\\:opacity-100');
                    
                    if (menuButton && submenu) {
                        let hoverTimeout;
                        let isHovering = false;
                        
                        // More precise hover detection - only on button
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                            submenu.classList.add('js-controlled');
                        });
                        
                        menuButton.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
                            // Check if mouse is moving to submenu
                            const rect = submenu.getBoundingClientRect();
                            const mouseX = e.clientX;
                            const mouseY = e.clientY;
                            
                            // If mouse is within submenu bounds, don't hide
                            if (mouseX >= rect.left && mouseX <= rect.right && 
                                mouseY >= rect.top && mouseY <= rect.bottom) {
                                return;
                            }
                            
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                if (!isHovering) {
                                    submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                                }
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Keep submenu open when hovering over it
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            clearTimeout(hoverTimeout);
                            isHovering = true;
                        });
                        
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                            isHovering = false;
                            hoverTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                                submenu.classList.remove('js-controlled');
                            }, 150);
                        });
                        
                        // Ensure submenu can receive mouse events when shown
                        submenu.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                            submenu.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // Check visibility on load and resize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            initializeDesktopSubmenuFix();
        });


    </script>
